name: fern-docs-mcp-server
description: MCP server for https://buildwithfern.com/learn documentation. Provides AI-powered search over the documentation.

tools.name: searchDocs
tools.description: Search the documentation at https://buildwithfern.com/learn. Returns ranked results with title, url, section anchor and a snippet, in rank order. Use fetchPage to read a result in full.

query.description: The search query to run against the docs

topK.description: How many results to return (default 8, max 20)

tools.name: fetchPage
tools.description: Read one page of the documentation at https://buildwithfern.com/learn as markdown. Takes a path or url from a searchDocs result.

path.description: Path or absolute url of the page to read, as returned in a searchDocs result's `url`

usage.cursor: Add "https://buildwithfern.com/learn/_mcp/server" to your MCP server configuration
usage.generic: POST JSON-RPC 2.0 messages to this URL
